confirmed.title: Avocado Work.app desktop bundle missing for make test-smoke
confirmed.repro: ls ui/desktop/out — directory absent; scripts/smoke-test.sh find Avocado Work.app fails
confirmed.evidence_summary: ui/desktop/out does not exist; smoke-findings.md and stress-status.json record test-smoke FAIL exit=2. SCOPE lists packaging installers out of scope, but make test-smoke still fails the smoke rung.

confirmed.title: Concurrent Goose 2.app process with separate userData
confirmed.repro: pgrep -fl 'Goose 2'; observe PID 10439 with userData Application Support/Goose alongside Avocado Work
confirmed.evidence_summary: Reconfirmed during judge: Goose 2.app still running (translocated path). Risk of typing into wrong window / confusion during UI stress.

confirmed.title: Vite renderer binds IPv6 localhost only
confirmed.repro: curl http://localhost:5173/ → 200; curl http://127.0.0.1:5173/ → connection fail; lsof shows [::1]:5173
confirmed.evidence_summary: Reconfirmed after relaunch on port 5173. Electron uses localhost so OK; harness/tools using 127.0.0.1 falsely report UI down.

not_reproducible.title: OnboardingGuard hiding chat-input as active typing failure
not_reproducible.reason: Code path exists, but after arena restore Electron logged React ready; no Electron DOM/screenshot evidence that welcome/server-error gate is currently blocking chat. Assistive/screenshot harness denied.

not_reproducible.title: Missing local goose serve in main.log as defect
not_reproducible.reason: make dev-ui intentionally uses GOOSE_EXTERNAL_BACKEND against docker make-dev ACP; absence of Starting goose serve is expected for this arena, not a product regression.

harness_bug.title: Browser Vite probe blank #root / missing chat-input
harness_bug.reason: Playwright Chromium lacks Electron preload (window.electron). Electron session shows React ready — not blank-root product failure.

harness_bug.title: Missing window.electron crashes SPA in browser probe
harness_bug.reason: Same harness gap: ExtensionInstallModal/App assume preload. Valid Electron-only assumption for shipped app; browser probe is not a supported surface.

harness_bug.title: Avocado Work/Vite died mid-investigation
harness_bug.reason: stress-status notes avcd_agent_killed=true (intentional kill of old tree). Leftover default_app Electron was environmental/harness cleanup side effect; restored via make dev-ui.

harness_bug.title: AppleScript keystroke blocked (assistive access)
harness_bug.reason: macOS privacy; not a product bug.

harness_bug.title: screencapture of Electron window denied
harness_bug.reason: Screen Recording permission; not a product bug.

harness_bug.title: Playwright browser revision mismatch
harness_bug.reason: Mitigated via channel:chrome; harness setup issue.

dismissed.title: GET /status returns 200 without X-Secret-Key
dismissed.rationale: Intentional unauthenticated health. Reproduced (200 ok) but product+unit test require this. /acp without secret → 401 (control).
dismissed.evidence_summary: Judge re-exec 200 ok; create_router mounts /status on aux_routes without check_acp_token; health_endpoints_skip_token_check.

dismissed.title: GET /status 200 with wrong X-Secret-Key
dismissed.rationale: Same intentional health behavior; secret ignored on /status.
dismissed.evidence_summary: Judge re-exec 200 ok; ACP with wrong secret still 401.

dismissed.title: GET /status 200 with empty X-Secret-Key
dismissed.rationale: Intentional; empty header irrelevant for public health route.

dismissed.title: GET /status 200 with 10KB X-Secret-Key
dismissed.rationale: Intentional; oversized invalid secret does not change public /status. No crash observed.

dismissed.title: TelemetryConsentPrompt blocking typing
dismissed.rationale: Config evidence shows GOOSE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED already true and GOOSE_PROVIDER absent — consent dialog path should not open. Not a typing gate.
dismissed.evidence_summary: Negative finding / config rules out telemetry as blocker.

judge_notes: /status and /health are intentionally unauthenticated health/liveness endpoints. Wired on aux_routes without auth middleware in crates/goose/src/acp/transport/mod.rs; unit test health_endpoints_skip_token_check asserts /health and /status return 200 without token. Auth applies to /acp (control: 401 without secret). SCOPE isolation oracle that required secrets on /status conflicts with product design — ISO-001..004 dismissed.
Browser blank-#root (UI-001/UI-002) is harness: Electron preload required. After relaunch, main.log shows Opening URL http://localhost:5173 and React ready (twice).
